narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Seven hundred eight is even. Seven hundred eight minus four hundred seventy seven goes in the even basket.
<bookmark mark='last'/>He looked only at the first number. Four hundred seventy seven is odd.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Even take away odd is odd, so that card belongs in the other basket.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Tag each number odd or even, then use the rules to decide.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Without working out, is three hundred five plus seven hundred nine even or odd? And seven times nine times three?
